name: run-finished-outcome-interrupt-populates-pending
description: RUN_FINISHED carrying an interrupt outcome closes the run without failing it, and the interrupt reaches the client intact rather than being stripped as unrecognised material
kill: drop RunFinishedInterruptOutcomeSchema from the RunFinishedOutcomeSchema union — enforcement then strips the outcome and warns "Removed unrecognised material at '/outcome' on RUN_FINISHED", which fails `noWarnings` (verified). Making the RUN_FINISHED case in verifyEvents treat an interrupt outcome as a failure kills the `completed` expectation the same way. NOTE: the interrupt itself lands on `agent.pendingInterrupts`, which the fixture format has no key for, so `noWarnings` is what stands in for "the outcome survived" here.

interrupts.message: Approve the transfer before the run continues.
